title: Airborne mapping of Maui's underground fresh water
summary: On April 22, a motion to use $1.8 million in water supply carryover savings for airborne electromagnetic data collection in West Maui was read into the record, though the vote result is not in the meeting video. The budget director said the administration would prefer the state lead the work, but the water director will move forward with the project. The proposing member said the data would show where to drill wells, and a second year would map the Haleakalā aquifer.
